summary: PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires repository-root and plan-dir, optional out; checks exactly one slice-receipt.json for each W0-W6 under logs/tdd-adapter/<plan>/<slice>; receipts must be JSON with predicate slice-ready, status pass, empty failures and authorizes; missing, invalid, or non-current receipts produce failures; emits schema toolchain-workflow-repair.terminal-result.v2 with predicate implementation-complete, pass only when no failures, empty authorizes, lifecycle_transition none; writes output file when requested and exits 0 on pass, 1 on failure
